data.title: 三司绫濑 · 写给自己的备注
data.description: 绫濑把明天的安排写进本子，在一项活动后面添了个问号。想了一会儿，她决定先把这个问题留到明天。
data.action: writing in a planner beside a window
data.promptProse: Seated at a bright window-side study desk, Ayase pauses with a pen above an open leather-bound schedule book, thoughtfully sketching a small question mark beside a calendar entry. Gentle afternoon sunlight streams across the desk surface, highlighting scattered stationery clips, a pastel ceramic mug, and a delicate potted succulent sitting on the sunny windowsill.
